Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Zongbao Daodu (宗寶道獨禪師語錄), in Zongbao Daodu's later raising of the Damei Fachang exchange. Mazu Daoyi is the exact quoted speaker of 即心即佛: Damei Fachang explicitly reports, 'Master Ma said to me: this mind is this buddha.' Damei is the reporter who says he consequently remained on the mountain, and Zongbao is the later raiser, not the speaker inside the quotation.
